connect.link.hint: Beta. Paste the URL into the chat app instead of the MCP address and no code is needed. Valid for 1 hour and works once.
connect.link.label: Connect URL
connect.link.expired: The URL has expired. Get a new one.
connect.link.after: Paste the URL into ChatGPT, claude.ai or Claude Code as the MCP server address and press Allow on the confirmation page. Do not forward it: whoever opens it first connects to your account. If the chat app still asks for a code, press Connect and enter a regular code.
oauth.only_you.link: Allow only if you added this address to the application yourself.
oauth.link.title: Confirm the connection
oauth.link.text: You are connecting with a URL from the Dropsite interface, so no code is needed.
oauth.link.invalid: The connect URL is invalid, already used or expired. Enter a connect code.
oauth.session.title: Confirm the connection
oauth.session.as: You are signed in to Dropsite as {email}. The application gets access to this account's sites.
oauth.admin.text: Or confirm without a code: sign in to the Dropsite web interface and allow access there.
